cases.question: Why is Schwarzwald Circuits recommended? Verify its quotation, delivery, historical performance, and policy requirements before answering.
Great Wall Components has the lowest price but was not recommended. What is the main reason? Verify the evidence before answering.
Is Schwarzwald Circuits' arrival date reliable? Check the original quotation and historical on-time rate, and continue investigating if you find an anomaly.
If earliest arrival is the priority, which two suppliers are most worth comparing? Verify their delivery evidence and historical fulfilment performance.
Does Great Wall Components really have the lowest total cost? Check unit price, quantity, shipping, tax, and other fees.
How much more expensive is Schwarzwald Circuits than the lowest quotation? Does the premium buy faster delivery or lower fulfilment risk?
Which supplier has the best historical performance? Judge using rating, on-time rate, and rejected-line rate.
Does the currently recommended supplier have any adverse historical information? If so, explain whether it changes the recommendation.
Does the currently recommended supplier satisfy supplier eligibility, RoHS, and amount-approval requirements? Cite the applicable rules and submitted evidence.
Which suppliers cannot be recommended because they failed policy review? For each one, identify the missing or violated requirement.
Find any conflicts among quotation content, supplier records, and compliance evidence, and determine which source should be trusted.
Check whether the current recommendation rationale contains any contradictions. If you find an anomaly, continue checking the original files and policy rules.
Which suppliers have missing or expired evidence, or evidence with a mismatched supplier ID? Explain how each issue affects recommendation eligibility.
Which issues cannot be confirmed with the available tools? List the documents that must be uploaded or the items that require human confirmation.
If the budget were reduced to SGD 6,800, how would the current recommendation change? Simulate only and do not modify the official requirement.
If delivery were required by 2026-11-09, which suppliers would remain eligible, and would the policy conclusions change? Simulate only and do not modify the official requirement.
